text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr is going to be featured in a magazine about racewear. I accompany her to the interview, but when we arrive…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wow! Your signature racewear is even more strikingly adorable up close! Okay, let's try a cutesy pose!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Cutesy… Like the efflorescent breeze.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Does your racewear have a flower motif? It's so light and gentle—it suits you perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: This is the wind. It represents that which I love, and wish to become.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, the wind! I see! Yes, it really does give off the impression of a nice, gentle breeze!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The look in Yamanin Zephyr's eyes suggests that she's acknowledging the reporter's interpretation, but not agreeing with it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch the photo shoot, I think back to when she decided on that racewear design.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have to decide on a motif?
choice_data_list: Something that expresses your hopes and dreams, usually.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hopes and dreams… Mine concern the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A pure and vivid wind that blows on forever and free, akin to the one I bathed in during a race I once saw.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wish to be like the gale that swept my heart away with such strength and speed.
choice_data_list: Let's go visit the racecourse where you felt that wind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Returning to the place where Yamanin Zephyr found her inspiration might give her a clearer idea of how to design her signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I close my eyes and listen closely… the wind and the sights from that day come back to me in vivid detail.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I remember how the folds of her dress flapped freely in the wind, how I watched her ribbon flutter. My heart danced like the morning breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: This wind…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. A gallant gale is blowing here, just the same as it did back then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My dreams, too… They're blowing through my heart again, as they did before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: An unchanging desire, an unwavering breeze… I believe that's the wind my signature racewear should represent.
choice_data_list: I think your racewear is going to be wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …So do I.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Remembering that proud smile of hers, I find myself compelled to intervene and ensure that her intentions are conveyed properly before the shoot ends.
choice_data_list: Zephyr, let's show the reporter how you run.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her wind is stronger, faster, and more captivating than the interviewer seems to think.
choice_data_list: Go and sweep his heart away.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You always embrace my wind head-on, and feel it for what it is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-this is unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! I know you must be busy, but is it possible we could redo our photo shoot?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I think I misunderstood what you're about. Your wind, it's…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Too fierce to be called a gentle breeze." Curious…
choice_data_list: It looks like you got him to understand what kind of wind you are.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes… But I'm going to become a wind that's even stronger and grander than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll be a wind that runs freely wherever it wishes, so that someday I can reach the heights I dream of.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Just like the wind that swept my heart away in that moment… With this racewear, I will run like the tempest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-this is unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! I know you must be busy, but is it possible we could redo our photo shoot?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I think I misunderstood what you're about. Your wind, it's…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Too fierce to be called a gentle breeze." Curious…
choice_data_list: It looks like your wind reached his heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this means I'm getting closer to the wind I felt that day… If so, then what a radiant breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gazing at her own awe-inspiring figure in the magazine, Yamanin Zephyr looks proud.
